Hyrox races, a standardized fitness competition format combining running with functional movements, are rapidly expanding across Asia and reshaping fitness culture. This trend represents a significant shift toward competitive functional fitness that directly aligns with the training methodologies used by TeamBuildr OS's target market of functional fitness gyms, CrossFit boxes, and sports performance facilities.
